ozone hole.d: an area of the ozone layer (near the poles) that is seasonally depleted of ozone

ozone layer.d: a layer in the stratosphere (at approximately 20 miles) that contains a concentration of ozone sufficient to block most ultraviolet radiation from the sun

ozone sickness.d: illness that can occur to persons exposed to ozone in high-altitude aircraft; characterized by sleepiness and headache and chest pains and itchiness

ozone.d: a colorless gas (O3) soluble in alkalis and cold water; a strong oxidizing agent

ozawa.d: United States conductor (born in Japan in 1935)

ozarks.d: an area of low mountains in northwestern Arkansas and southeastern Missouri and northeastern Oklahoma

ozena.d: a chronic disease of the nose characterized by a foul-smelling nasal discharge and atrophy of nasal structures

ozonide.d: any of a class of unstable chemical compounds resulting from the addition of ozone to a double bond in an unsaturated compound

ozokerite.d: a waxy mineral that is a mixture of hydrocarbons and occurs in association with petroleum; some varieties are used in making ceresin and candles

ozocerite.d: a waxy mineral that is a mixture of hydrocarbons and occurs in association with petroleum; some varieties are used in making ceresin and candles
